description.zh: 指定查询的关键词。对安全组ID/名称进行搜索，均支持模糊搜索。
description.en: The keyword of the query. You can perform a fuzzy search on security group ID or name.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为 100。
默认值：
当不设置值或设置的值小于 10 时，默认值为 10。
当设置的值大于 100 时，默认值为 100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: If you do not specify this parameter or if you set a value smaller than 10, the default value is 10. If you set a value greater than 100, the default value is 100.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.

description.zh:
分页查询时跳过的条目数。
当跳过的条目数超过符合条件的条目总数时，会返回空列表。
description.en: The number of entries to be skipped in the query. If the number of entries you attempt to skip exceeds the number of entries that meet the condition, an empty list is returned.

description.zh:
指定查询的排序规则，用于按安全组的创建时间排序。默认是asc。
可选值：desc（降序排序），asc（升序排序）。
description.en: The sorting order of the security groups by creation time. Default value: asc. Valid values: desc and asc. asc indicates the ascending order, and desc indicates the descending order.

title.zh: 查询媒体直播输入安全组列表

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口查询媒体直播输入安全组列表。

## QPS 限制
本接口的单用户 QPS 限制为 50 次/秒。超过限制，API 调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit

This operation can be called up to 50 times per second for each Alibaba Cloud account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.
